info.longName: First Trust Active Factor Emerging Markets Fund

funds_data.description: The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of emerging market companies. It will invest in equity securities listed and traded on U.S. and non-U.S. exchanges and depositary receipts. Such equity securities may include common stock and depositary receipts (including American Depositary Receipts (“ADRs”), European Depositary Receipts (“EDRs”), Canadian Depositary Receipts (“CDRs”) and Global Depositary Receipts (“GDRs”)). The fund may invest in small, mid and large capitalization companies.
